title: merremia cissoides f. major
intro: Merremia cissoides f. major, commonly known as the "Tropical Passion Flower," is a plant species native to tropical and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Merremia cissoides f. major include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anticonvulsant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, alkaloids, such as passionflower alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
